units.zh: 尉瑾 馮子琮 赫連子悅 唐邕 白建
units.en: Yu Jin; Feng Zicong; Helian Ziyue; Tang Yong; Bai Jian
units.literal: Yu Jin; Feng Zicong; Helian Ziyue; Tang Yong; Bai Jian

units.zh: 尉瑾，字安仁。
units.en: Yu Jin, styled Anren.
units.literal: Yu Jin, styled Anren.

units.zh: 父慶賓，為魏肆州刺史。
units.en: His father Qingbin had been Wei governor of Sizhou.
units.literal: His father Qingbin was Wei governor of Sizhou.

units.zh: 瑾少而敏悟，好學慕善。
units.en: From youth Jin was quick-witted, loved study, and sought what was good.
units.literal: Jin from youth was quick and perceptive, loved learning, and admired goodness.

units.zh: 稍遷直後。
units.en: He rose in turn to straight attendant.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to straight attendant.

units.zh: 司馬子如執政，瑾取其外生皮氏女，由此擢拜中書舍人。
units.en: When Sima Ziru held power, Jin married his maternal niece of the Pi clan and was promoted secretariat vice-director.
units.literal: When Sima Ziru held power, Jin took his maternal niece, daughter of the Pi clan, and was thereby promoted and appointed secretariat vice-director.

units.zh: 旣是子如姻戚，數往參詣，因與先達名輩微相款狎。
units.en: As Ziru's kin by marriage he often called on him and grew familiar with eminent elders and men of name.
units.literal: Being Ziru's affinal kin, he often went to call on him and thereby came to be on easy terms with eminent predecessors and noted men of the age.

units.zh: 世宗入朝，因命瑾在鄴北宮共高德正典機密。
units.en: When Gao Cheng came to court, Jin was ordered to Ye's northern palace to manage confidential affairs with Gao Dezheng.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng entered the court, Jin was ordered to be at Ye's northern palace together with Gao Dezheng managing confidential affairs.

units.zh: 肅宗輔政，累遷吏部尚書。
units.en: When Gao Yan assisted in government, Jin rose repeatedly to minister of personnel.
units.literal: When Gao Yan assisted in government, Jin was repeatedly promoted to minister of personnel.

units.zh: 世祖踐祚，趙彥深本子如賓僚，元文遙、和士開並帝鄉故舊，共相薦達，任遇彌重。
units.en: When Gao Zhan took the throne, Zhao Yanshen had been Ziru's guest-officer, and Yuan Wenyao and He Shikai were all old friends from the imperial hometown. They recommended him together, and his rank and favor grew heavier still.
units.literal: When Gao Zhan ascended the throne, Zhao Yanshen had been a guest-officer of Ziru, Yuan Wenyao and He Shikai were all old acquaintances from the imperial hometown, and they jointly recommended and advanced him; his appointment and favor grew ever heavier.

units.zh: 又吏部銓衡所歸，事多秘密，由是朝之幾事，頗亦預聞。
units.en: Personnel weighing and selection also rested with him; much was secret, and so he often heard the court's weighty affairs in advance.
units.literal: Moreover the personnel directorate's weighing and selection fell to him; affairs were mostly secret, and thereby he often heard beforehand of the court's weighty matters.

units.zh: 尋兼右僕射，攝選，未幾即真。
units.en: Soon he was also right vice director, acting in selection; before long the post was made formal.
units.literal: Soon he was additionally right vice director, acting in selection; before long he received the formal appointment.

units.zh: 病卒，世祖方在三臺飲酒，文遙奏聞，遂命徹樂罷飲。
units.en: He died of illness while Gao Zhan was drinking at Santai. Wenyao reported it, and the emperor ordered the music stopped and the drinking ended.
units.literal: He died of illness; Gao Zhan was at the time drinking at Santai; Wenyao reported it, and the emperor ordered music withdrawn and drinking stopped.

units.zh: 瑾外雖通顯，內闕風訓，閨門穢雜，為世所鄙。
units.en: Outwardly Jin was eminent, but at home he lacked moral discipline; his inner quarters were foul and disorderly, and the age despised him.
units.literal: Outwardly Jin was prominent, but inwardly his household lacked moral instruction; his inner chambers were foul and mixed, and the age despised him for it.

units.zh: 然亦能折節下士，意在引接名流，但不別之。
units.en: Yet he could humble himself before scholars and meant to draw in men of name—only he could not tell them apart.
units.literal: Yet he could also restrain himself and defer to scholars, meaning to draw in eminent men—but he did not distinguish them.

units.zh: 及官高任重，便大躁急，省內郎中將論事者逆即瞋詈，不可諮承。
units.en: Once rank and burden grew heavy he turned harsh and quick to anger. Within the ministry, any lang who came to discuss business and crossed him was glared at and cursed on the spot; none could seek his counsel.
units.literal: When his office was high and his burden heavy, he became greatly impatient; within the ministry, those lang who wished to discuss affairs—if they went against him he would glare and curse at once, and they could not consult with him.

units.zh: 旣居大選，彌自驕狠。
units.en: Once he held the great selection he grew still more arrogant and cruel.
units.literal: Once he held the great selection, he became all the more arrogant and harsh.

units.zh: 子德載嗣。
units.en: His son Dezai succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Dezai succeeded him.

units.zh: 馮子琮，信都人，北燕主馮跋之後也。
units.en: Feng Zicong came from Xindu and was descended from Northern Yan's ruler Feng Ba.
units.literal: Feng Zicong, a man of Xindu, was a descendant of Northern Yan's ruler Feng Ba.

units.zh: 父靈紹，度支郎中。
units.en: His father Lingshao was a lang in the revenue section.
units.literal: His father Lingshao was a lang in the revenue section.

units.zh: 子琮性聰敏，涉獵書傳。
units.en: Zicong was clever by nature and read widely in books and records.
units.literal: Zicong was clever by nature and ranged through books and records.

units.zh: 為。
units.en: He then entered official service.
units.literal: He took office.

units.zh: 肅宗除領軍府法曹，典機密，攝庫部。
units.en: Gao Yan made him law staff in the general-in-chief's office, put him in charge of confidential affairs, and had him act in the treasury section.
units.literal: Gao Yan appointed him to the staff bureau for law in the general-in-chief's office, managing confidential affairs and acting in the treasury section.

units.zh: 肅宗曾閱簿領，試令口陳，子琮闇對，無有遺失。
units.en: Gao Yan once reviewed ledgers and tested Zicong by having him recite them aloud. Zicong answered from memory without missing a single entry.
units.literal: Gao Yan once reviewed ledgers; testing them, he had Zicong recite orally—and Zicong answered from memory without a single omission.

units.zh: 子琮妻，胡皇后妹也。
units.en: Zicong's wife was the Hu empress's younger sister.
units.literal: Zicong's wife was the younger sister of the Hu empress.

units.zh: 遷殿中郎，加東宮管記。
units.en: He was promoted palace attendant and also made eastern palace recorder.
units.literal: He was promoted to attendant within the palace and additionally made eastern palace recorder.

units.zh: 又奉別詔，令共胡長粲輔遵太子，轉庶子。
units.en: By a separate edict he was to assist the crown prince with Hu Changcai and was transferred to heir-apparent subprefect.
units.literal: He was further given a separate edict to assist the crown prince together with Hu Changcai; he was transferred to subprefect of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 天統元年，世祖禪位後主。
units.en: In the first year of Tiantong, Shizu abdicated in favor of the Later Sovereign.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiantong, Shizu abdicated in favor of the Later Sovereign.

units.zh: 世祖御正殿，謂子琮曰：「少君左右宜得正人，以卿心存正直，今以後事相委。」
units.en: Shizu sat in the main hall and told Zicong, "The young lord should have upright men around him. Because your heart is upright and true, I now entrust later affairs to you."
units.literal: Shizu sat in the main hall and said to Zicong, "The young lord should have upright men at his side. Because your heart is upright and true, I now entrust later affairs to you."

units.zh: 除給事黃門侍郎，領主衣都統。
units.en: He was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently Chief Commander of Imperial Clothing.
units.literal: He was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently Chief Commander of Imperial Clothing.

units.zh: 世祖在晉陽，旣居舊殿，少帝未有別所，詔子琮監造大明宮。
units.en: When Shizu was at Jinyang, he occupied the old palace, while the young emperor had no separate residence, so he ordered Zicong to supervise construction of the Daming Palace.
units.literal: When Shizu was at Jinyang, he already occupied the old palace, and the young emperor had no separate quarters, so he ordered Zicong to supervise construction of the Daming Palace.

units.zh: 宮成，世祖親自巡幸，怪其不甚宏麗。
units.en: When the palace was completed, Shizu personally toured it and was surprised that it was not especially grand or splendid.
units.literal: When the palace was completed, Shizu personally toured it and wondered that it was not very grand and splendid.

units.zh: 子琮對曰：「至尊幼年，纂承大業，欲令敦行節儉，以示萬邦。
units.en: Zicong replied, "The sovereign is young and has inherited the great enterprise; I wanted him to practice sincere frugality as a model for the realm.
units.literal: Zicong replied, "The sovereign is young and has inherited the great enterprise; I wanted him to practice sincere frugality and show it to the ten thousand states.

units.zh: 兼此北連天闕，不宜過復崇峻。」
units.en: Moreover, this palace connects northward to the Heavenly Gate, so it should not be made too lofty and imposing."
units.literal: Moreover, this palace connects northward to the Heavenly Gate, so it should not again be excessively lofty and imposing."

units.zh: 世祖稱善。
units.en: Shizu approved.
units.literal: Shizu praised this.

units.zh: 及世祖崩，僕射和士開先恒侍疾，秘喪三日不發。
units.en: When Gao Zhan died, vice director He Shikai had long attended his illness and kept the mourning secret for three days without announcing it.
units.literal: When Gao Zhan died, Vice Director He Shikai had long attended his illness and kept the mourning secret for three days without announcing it.

units.zh: 子琮問士開不發喪之意。
units.en: Zicong asked He Shikai why he had not announced the mourning.
units.literal: Zicong asked He Shikai why he did not announce the mourning.

units.zh: 士開引神武、文襄初崩並秘喪不舉，至尊年少，恐王公有貳心，意欲普追集涼風堂，然後與詳議。
units.en: He Shikai said that when Gao Huan and Gao Cheng first died, mourning had likewise been kept secret. The sovereign was young; he feared the princes and dukes might waver, and meant to gather everyone at the Cool Breeze Hall before discussing matters in full.
units.literal: He Shikai cited that when Gao Huan and Gao Cheng first died, mourning was likewise kept secret; the sovereign was young and he feared the princes and dukes might harbor divided hearts; he intended to summon everyone to the Cool Breeze Hall and then discuss in detail.

units.zh: 時太尉錄尚書事趙郡王叡先恒居內，預帷幄之謀，子琮素知士開忌叡及領軍臨淮王婁定遠，恐其矯遺詔出叡外任，奪定遠禁衛之權，因答云：「大行，神武之子，今上又是先皇傳位，群臣富貴者皆是至尊父子之恩，但令在內貴臣一無改易，王公已下必無異望。
units.en: At the time grand mentor and recorder of the masters of writing affairs, Prince of Zhao commandery Rui, had long lived inside the palace and shared counsel at the curtain. Zicong knew He Shikai resented Rui and general-in-chief of the guards Prince of Linhuai Lou Dingyuan and feared they might forge the final edict to send Rui out on provincial duty and strip Dingyuan of the guard command. He answered, "The late emperor was Gao Huan's son, and the present sovereign too received the throne from his predecessor. Every minister's wealth came from the sovereign father and son. Leave the great men inside the court unchanged, and the princes and dukes below will surely have no other wish.
units.literal: At the time Grand Mentor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing Affairs Prince of Zhao commandery Rui had long dwelt within the palace and took part in counsel at the curtain; Zicong had long known He Shikai resented Rui and General-in-Chief of the Guards Prince of Linhuai Lou Dingyuan, and feared they might forge the final edict to send Rui out on external appointment and strip Dingyuan of guard authority; therefore he answered, saying, "The late emperor was Gao Huan's son, and the present sovereign likewise received the throne from the former emperor. Every minister's wealth and rank came from father and son's grace to the sovereign. If the honored men within the court are left wholly unchanged, the princes and dukes below will surely harbor no other intent.

units.zh: 世異事殊，不得與霸朝相比。
units.en: Times and affairs differ; this cannot be compared with the founding reign.
units.literal: Times and affairs differ; this cannot be compared with the founding reign.

units.zh: 且公出宮門已經數日，升遐之事，行路皆傳，久而不舉，恐有他變。」
units.en: Moreover, sir, you have been outside the palace gates for days already, and news of the emperor's passing travels every road. Delay mourning too long and I fear some other turn may come."
units.literal: Moreover, sir, you have been outside the palace gates already several days; news of the emperor's passing spreads on every road. If mourning is long delayed, I fear some other change may arise."

units.zh: 於是乃發喪。
units.en: Thereupon mourning was announced.
units.literal: Thereupon mourning was announced.

units.zh: 元文遙以子琮太后妹夫，恐其獎成太后干政，說趙郡王及士開出之，拜鄭州刺史，即令之任。
units.en: Yuan Wenyao, because Zicong was the empress's brother-in-law, feared he would encourage her to meddle in government. He persuaded Prince of Zhao commandery and He Shikai to send him out, made him governor of Zheng, and ordered him to take up the post at once.
units.literal: Yuan Wenyao, because Zicong was the empress's brother-in-law, feared he would encourage the empress to meddle in government; he persuaded Prince of Zhao commandery and He Shikai to send him out, appointed him governor of Zhengzhou, and ordered him to take up the post at once.

units.zh: 子琮除州，非後主本意，中旨殷勤，特給後部鼓吹，加兵五十人，並聽將物度關。
units.en: Zicong's provincial appointment was not what the Later Sovereign had first intended; the central edict was warm and earnest, and he was specially given rear guard musicians, fifty more troops, and leave to bring goods across the passes.
units.literal: Zicong's appointment to the province was not the Later Sovereign's original intent; the central edict was earnest and warm, and he was specially given rear guard musicians, fifty additional troops, and permission to bring goods across the passes.

units.zh: 至州未幾，太后為齊安王納子琮長女為妃，子琮因請假赴鄴，遂授吏部尚書。
units.en: Not long after he reached the province, the empress dowager took Zicong's eldest daughter as consort for Prince of Qi'an. Zicong asked leave to go to Ye and was then made minister of personnel.
units.literal: Not long after he reached the province, the empress dowager took Zicong's eldest daughter as consort for Prince of Qi'an; Zicong therefore asked leave to go to Ye and was then appointed minister of personnel.

units.zh: 其妻恃親放縱，請謁公行，賄貨填積。
units.en: His wife relied on kinship and acted without restraint; favors and audiences went openly, and bribes piled high.
units.literal: His wife relied on kinship and acted without restraint; requests and audiences went openly, and bribes piled up.

units.zh: 守宰除授，先定錢帛多少，然後奏聞，其所通致，事無不允，子琮亦不禁制。
units.en: For prefects and magistrates the price in cash and silk was fixed first and only then reported upward. Whatever they sought through him was granted, and Zicong did not restrain them.
units.literal: When prefects and magistrates were appointed, the amount of cash and silk was fixed first and only then reported to the throne; whatever they sought through him was never denied, and Zicong did not restrain it.

units.zh: 俄遷尚書右僕射，仍攝選。
units.en: Before long he was promoted right vice director of the masters of writing and still acted in selection.
units.literal: Before long he was promoted to right vice director of the masters of writing and still acted in selection.

units.zh: 和士開居要日久，子琮舊所附托，卑辭曲躬，事事諮稟。
units.en: He Shikai had long held power; Zicong had once relied on him, spoke humbly, bowed low, and consulted him on every matter.
units.literal: He Shikai had long held a key post; Zicong had once relied on him and with humble words and bent body consulted him on every matter.

units.zh: 士開弟休與盧氏婚，子琮檢校趨走，與士開府僚不異。
units.en: He Shikai's younger brother Xiu married into the Lu clan; Zicong hurried about at the wedding no differently from He Shikai's own staff.
units.literal: He Shikai's younger brother Xiu married into the Lu clan; Zicong attended and hurried about no differently from He Shikai's staff.

units.zh: 是時內官除授多由士開奏擬，子琮旣恃內戚，兼帶選曹，自擅權寵，頗生間隙。
units.en: At the time many inner appointments came from He Shikai's proposals. Zicong, relying on inner kinship and also holding the selection office, monopolized favor and power, and friction grew between them.
units.literal: At the time many inner appointments were proposed by He Shikai; Zicong, relying on inner kinship and also holding the selection office, monopolized favor and power, and friction arose.

units.zh: 瑯邪王儼殺士開，子琮與其事，就內省絞殺之。
units.en: Prince of Langye Yan killed He Shikai; Zicong took part in the affair and strangled him inside the inner secretariat.
units.literal: Prince of Langye Yan killed He Shikai; Zicong took part in the affair and strangled him inside the inner secretariat.

units.zh: 子琮微有識鑒，及位望轉隆，宿心頓改。
units.en: Zicong had some discernment, but as rank and renown rose his old intent suddenly changed.
units.literal: Zicong had some discernment, but as rank and renown rose his long-held intent suddenly changed.

units.zh: 擢引非類，以為深交；
units.en: He promoted unworthy men and treated them as close friends;
units.literal: He promoted and drew in unworthy sorts and treated them as close friends;

units.zh: 縱其子弟，官位不依倫次；
units.en: he indulged his sons and younger brothers, giving offices out of proper order;
units.literal: he indulged his sons and younger brothers, giving offices out of proper order;

units.zh: 又專營婚媾，歷選上門，例以官爵許之，旬日便驗。
units.en: he also specialized in arranging marriages, choosing only great houses, and routinely promised office and rank that were confirmed within ten days.
units.literal: he also specialized in arranging marriages, choosing only great houses, and routinely promised office and rank; within ten days it was confirmed.

units.zh: 子慈正。
units.en: His son was Cizheng.
units.literal: His son Cizheng.

units.zh: 赫連子悅，字士欣，勃勃之後也。
units.en: Helian Ziyue, styled Shixin, was descended from Helian Bobo.
units.literal: Helian Ziyue, styled Shixin, was a descendant of Helian Bobo.

units.zh: 魏永安初，以軍功為濟州別駕。
units.en: In Wei's first Yong'an year he was made Jizhou separate-assistant for military merit.
units.literal: In the first year of Yong'an under Wei he was made, for military merit, separate-assistant of Jizhou.

units.zh: 及高祖起義，侯景為刺史，景本尒朱心腹，子悅勸景起義，景從之。
units.en: When Gao Huan raised the righteous army, Hou Jing was governor. Jing had been Erzhu Rong's trusted man; Ziyue urged him to join the uprising, and Jing followed.
units.literal: When Gao Huan raised the righteous army, Hou Jing was governor; Jing had originally been Erzhu Rong's trusted man, and Ziyue urged Jing to join the uprising; Jing followed him.

units.zh: 除林慮守。
units.en: He was appointed defender of Linyu.
units.literal: He was appointed defender of Linyu.

units.zh: 世宗往晉陽，路由是郡，因問所不便。
units.en: Gao Cheng was bound for Jinyang and passed through the commandery, so he asked what was inconvenient.
units.literal: Gao Cheng was going to Jinyang and passed through that commandery; he therefore asked what was inconvenient.

units.zh: 悅答云：「臨水、武安二縣去郡遙遠，山嶺重疊，車步艱難，若東屬魏郡，則地平路近。」
units.en: Ziyue answered, "The counties of Linshui and Wu'an lie far from the seat; mountains pile up and travel by cart or on foot is hard. If they were placed under Wei's commandery to the east, the land would be level and the road short."
units.literal: Ziyue answered, saying, "The two counties of Linshui and Wu'an lie far from the commandery seat; mountains and ridges overlap, and cart and foot travel are hard. If they were attached east to Wei's commandery, the land would be level and the road near."

units.zh: 世宗笑曰：「卿徒知便民，不覺損幹。」
units.en: Gao Cheng laughed and said, "You only know how to ease the people and do not see the harm to the trunk."
units.literal: Gao Cheng laughed and said, "You only know how to benefit the people and do not notice the harm to the trunk."

units.zh: 子悅答云：「所言因民疾苦，不敢以私潤負心。」
units.en: Ziyue answered, "What I said follows the people's hardship; I dare not let private gain outweigh my heart."
units.literal: Ziyue answered, saying, "What I spoke of follows the people's hardship; I dare not let private gain outweigh my heart."

units.zh: 世宗云：「卿能如此，甚善甚善。」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "You can be like this—excellent, excellent."
units.literal: Gao Cheng said, "You can be like this—very good, very good."

units.zh: 仍勑依事施行。
units.en: He then ordered the change carried out as proposed.
units.literal: He then ordered it carried out according to the proposal.

units.zh: 在郡滿，更徵為臨漳令。
units.en: When his commandery term ended he was summoned again as magistrate of Linzhang.
units.literal: When his term in the commandery was complete, he was summoned again as magistrate of Linzhang.

units.zh: 後除鄭州刺史，于時新經河清大水，民多逃散，子悅親加恤隱，戶口益增，治為天下之最。
units.en: Later he was made governor of Zheng. The region had just suffered the Heqing great flood; many people had fled. Ziyue went in person to comfort them, households increased, and his governance ranked first in the realm.
units.literal: Later he was made governor of Zhengzhou; at the time the region had just suffered the great flood of the Heqing era, and the people had fled in great numbers; Ziyue personally went to comfort and shelter them, households increased, and his governance ranked first in the realm.

units.zh: 入為都官尚書，鄭州民八百餘請立碑頌德，有詔許焉。
units.en: He entered court as director of the ministry of justice. More than eight hundred men of Zheng asked to raise a stele praising his virtue, and an edict permitted it.
units.literal: He entered court as director of the ministry of justice; more than eight hundred men of Zhengzhou asked to erect a stele praising his virtue, and an edict permitted it.

units.zh: 後以本官兼吏部。
units.en: Later, while keeping his original office, he was additionally made acting in the personnel directorate.
units.literal: Later, in his original office, he was additionally made acting in the personnel directorate.

units.zh: 子悅在官，唯以清勤自守，旣無學術，又闕風儀，人倫清鑒，去之彌遠，一旦居銓衡之首，大招物議。
units.en: In office Ziyue held himself only by purity and diligence. He had neither learning nor bearing, and in judging men he fell ever farther short—yet once he stood at the head of weighing and selection, he drew heavy criticism.
units.literal: Ziyue in office relied only on purity and diligence to hold himself; he had neither learning nor bearing, and in human discernment he fell ever farther away—yet once he stood at the head of weighing and selection, he drew great criticism from the age.

units.zh: 由是除太常卿，卒。
units.en: Thereupon he was made director of the ministry of rites and died.
units.literal: Thereupon he was made director of the ministry of rites and died.

units.zh: 唐邕，字道和，太原晉陽人，其先自晉昌徙焉。
units.en: Tang Yong, styled Daohe, came from Jinyang in Taiyuan; his ancestors had moved there from Jinchang.
units.literal: Tang Yong, styled Daohe, was a man of Jinyang in Taiyuan; his ancestors had moved there from Jinchang.

units.zh: 父靈芝，魏壽陽令。
units.en: His father Lingzhi was Wei magistrate of Shouyang.
units.literal: His father Lingzhi was Wei magistrate of Shouyang.

units.zh: 邕少明敏，有治世才具。
units.en: Yong was bright and keen from youth and had the talent to order an age.
units.literal: Yong from youth was bright and keen and had the talent and equipment to order an age.

units.zh: 太昌初，或薦於高祖，命其直外兵曹，典執文帳。
units.en: In the first Taichang year someone recommended him to Gao Huan, who had him attend the outer military affairs bureau and manage written registers.
units.literal: In the first year of Taichang someone recommended him to Gao Huan; Gao Huan ordered him to attend the outer military affairs bureau and manage written registers.

units.zh: 邕善書計，強記默識，以幹濟見知，擢為世宗大將軍府參軍。
units.en: Yong was skilled at reckoning and accounts, remembered silently, and was known for practical ability. He was promoted staff officer in Gao Cheng's grand general's office.
units.literal: Yong was skilled at reckoning and accounts, had a strong memory and silent retention, and was known for practical ability; he was promoted staff officer in Gao Cheng's grand general's office.

units.zh: 及世宗崩，事出倉卒，顯祖部分將士，鎮壓四方，夜中召邕支配，造次便了，顯祖甚重之。
units.en: When Gao Cheng died, affairs broke out in haste. Gao Yang deployed generals and soldiers to hold the four quarters, summoned Yong at night to arrange matters, and at once it was done. Gao Yang valued him greatly.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng died, affairs arose in sudden haste; Gao Yang deployed the generals and soldiers and suppressed the four quarters; in the night he summoned Yong to arrange matters, and at once it was done—Gao Yang valued him greatly.

units.zh: 顯祖頻年出塞，邕必陪從，專掌兵機。
units.en: Year after year Gao Yang went beyond the frontier; Yong always accompanied him and specialized in military plans.
units.literal: Gao Yang year after year went beyond the frontier; Yong always accompanied him and specialized in military plans.

units.zh: 識悟閑明，承受敏速，自督將以還，軍吏以上，勞效由緒，無不諳練，每有顧問，占對如響。
units.en: His discernment was clear and unhurried, his reception quick. From supervising generals down and army clerks up, merit and service followed the thread and none was unfamiliar; whenever he was asked, he answered like an echo.
units.literal: His discernment was clear and unhurried, his reception quick; from supervising generals down, and military clerks and above, merit and service followed the thread and none was unfamiliar—whenever there was inquiry, his reply came like an echo.

units.zh: 或於御前簡閱，雖三五千人，邕多不執文簿，暗唱官位姓名，未常謬誤。
units.en: Sometimes the emperor reviewed troops before him; though three or five thousand men, Yong often held no ledger and recited office, rank, and name from memory without error.
units.literal: Sometimes before the emperor he would review troops; though three to five thousand men, Yong often held no ledger and would recite in the dark their offices, ranks, and names, and never erred.

units.zh: 七年，於羊汾堤講武，令邕總為諸軍節度。
units.en: In the seventh year, at the Yangfen embankment, he lectured on military affairs and ordered Yong to command discipline for all armies.
units.literal: In the seventh year, at the Yangfen embankment he lectured on military affairs and ordered Yong to command the discipline of all armies.

units.zh: 事畢，仍監宴射之禮。
units.en: When the affair ended he still oversaw the review feast and archery ritual.
units.literal: When the affair was finished, he still oversaw the ritual of the review feast and archery.

units.zh: 是日，顯祖親執邕手，引至太后前，坐於丞相斛律金之上，啟太后云：「唐邕強幹，一人當千。」
units.en: That day Gao Yang took Yong's hand, led him before the empress dowager, seated him above chancellor Hulü Jin, and told her, "Tang Yong is strong and capable—one man equals a thousand."
units.literal: That day Gao Yang personally took Yong's hand, led him before the empress dowager, seated him above Chancellor Hulü Jin, and told the empress dowager, saying, "Tang Yong is strong and capable—one man equals a thousand."

units.zh: 仍別賜錦彩錢帛。
units.en: He then separately bestowed brocade, silk, cash, and goods.
units.literal: He then separately bestowed brocade, silk, cash, and goods.

units.zh: 邕非唯強濟明辨，然亦善揣上意，進取多途，是以恩寵日隆，委任彌重。
units.en: Yong was not only strong, capable, bright, and discerning; he also knew how to read the sovereign's intent and had many paths of advance, so favor grew daily and commission grew heavier.
units.literal: Yong was not only strong, capable, bright, and discerning; he also knew how to gauge the sovereign's intent, and his paths of advancement were many—therefore favor daily grew and commission grew ever heavier.

units.zh: 顯祖又嘗對邕白太后云：「唐邕分明強記，每有軍機大事，手作文書，口且處分，耳又聽受，實是異人。」
units.en: Gao Yang also once told the empress dowager before Yong, "Tang Yong distinguishes clearly and remembers strongly. On great military affairs he writes documents by hand, gives orders by mouth, and listens with his ear at once—truly a different man."
units.literal: Gao Yang also once said to Yong before the empress dowager, "Tang Yong distinguishes clearly and remembers strongly; whenever there is a weighty military affair, he writes documents by hand, gives orders by mouth, and listens with his ear at the same time—truly a different man."

units.zh: 一日之中，六度賜物。
units.en: In a single day he was given gifts six times.
units.literal: In a single day he was six times given gifts.

units.zh: 又嘗解所服青鼠皮裘賜邕，云：「朕意在車馬衣裘與卿共弊。」
units.en: He also once removed the blue sable coat he was wearing and gave it to Yong, saying, "My intent is that carriages, horses, clothes, and furs be worn out together with you."
units.literal: He also once removed the blue sable fur coat he was wearing and bestowed it on Yong, saying, "My intent is that carriages, horses, clothes, and furs be worn out together with you."

units.zh: 十年，從幸晉陽，除兼給事黃門侍郎，領中書舍人。
units.en: In the tenth year, on the progress to Jinyang, Yong was made acting attendant of the yellow gate and leading secretariat vice-director.
units.literal: In the tenth year, accompanying the imperial progress to Jinyang, he was made acting attendant of the yellow gate and leading secretariat vice-director.

units.zh: 顯祖嘗登童子佛寺，望幷州城曰：「此是何等城？」
units.en: Gao Yang once climbed Tongzi Buddhist temple, looked toward Bingzhou city, and said, "What sort of city is this?"
units.literal: Gao Yang once ascended the Tongzi Buddhist temple, looked toward Bingzhou city, and said, "What sort of city is this?"

units.zh: 或曰：「此是金城湯池，天府之國。」
units.en: Someone said, "This is a metal rampart and boiling moat—the realm's heavenly storehouse."
units.literal: Someone said, "This is a metal rampart and boiling moat, a realm of heaven's storehouse."

units.zh: 帝云：「我謂唐邕是金城，此非金城也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "I say Tang Yong is the metal rampart; this is not the metal rampart."
units.literal: The emperor said, "I say Tang Yong is the metal rampart; this is not the metal rampart."

units.zh: 其見重如此。
units.en: Such was the weight in which he was held.
units.literal: Such was the weight in which he was held.

units.zh: 其後語邕曰：「卿劬勞旣久，欲除卿作州，頻勑楊遵彥更求一人堪代卿者。
units.en: Afterward he said to Yong, "Your toil has been long. I wished to make you governor of a province and repeatedly ordered Yang Zunyan to find another man who could replace you.
units.literal: Afterward he said to Yong, "Your toil has been long; I wished to make you governor of a province and repeatedly ordered Yang Zunyan to find another man who could replace you.

units.zh: 遵彥云比遍訪文武，如卿之徒實不可得，所以遂停此意。
units.en: Zunyan said that having searched civil and military men everywhere, a man like you truly cannot be found, and so this intent was stopped.
units.literal: Zunyan said that having searched everywhere among civil and military men, men like you truly cannot be obtained, and so this intent was stopped.

units.zh: 卿宜勉之。」
units.en: You should strive on."
units.literal: You should strive on."

units.zh: 顯祖或時切責侍臣不稱旨者：「觀卿等舉措，不中與唐邕作奴。」
units.en: Gao Yang sometimes sharply rebuked attending ministers who missed his intent: "Watch how you comport yourselves—you are not fit to be Tang Yong's slaves."
units.literal: Gao Yang sometimes sharply rebuked attending ministers who did not suit his intent: "Watch how you comport yourselves—you are not fit to be Tang Yong's slaves."

units.zh: 其見賞遇多此類。
units.en: His favor and treatment were mostly of this sort.
units.literal: His favor and treatment were mostly of this sort.

units.zh: 肅宗作相，除黃門侍郎。
units.en: When Gao Yan was made chief minister, Yong was made attendant of the yellow gate.
units.literal: When Gao Yan was made chief minister, Yong was made attendant of the yellow gate.

units.zh: 於華林園射，特賜金帶寶器服玩雜物五百種。
units.en: At the Hualin Garden archery review he was specially given five hundred kinds of gold belts, precious vessels, robes, playthings, and miscellaneous goods.
units.literal: At the Hualin Garden archery review he was specially given five hundred kinds of gold belts, precious vessels, robes, playthings, and miscellaneous goods.

units.zh: 天統初，除侍中、幷州大中正，又拜護軍，餘如故。
units.en: Early in Tiantong he was made Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Rectifier of Bing Province, and was again appointed General Who Protects the Army; his remaining offices stayed as before.
units.literal: Early in Tiantong he was made Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Rectifier of Bing Province, and was again appointed General Who Protects the Army; his remaining offices stayed as before.

units.zh: 邕以軍民教習田獵，依令十二月，月別三圍，以為人馬疲敝，奏請每月兩圍。
units.en: Yong thought military and civilian field-hunt instruction, which by statute ran three hunts each month in the twelfth month, wore out men and horses, and memorialized for two hunts each month.
units.literal: Yong, because military and civilian instruction in field hunts followed the statute of the twelfth month with three hunts each month, thought men and horses were worn out and memorialized asking for two hunts each month.

units.zh: 世祖從之。
units.en: Gao Zhan approved it.
units.literal: Gao Zhan followed it.

units.zh: 後出為趙州刺史，餘官如故。
units.en: Later he went out as governor of Zhao; his other offices remained as before.
units.literal: Later he went out as governor of Zhao province; his other offices remained as before.

units.zh: 世祖謂邕曰：「朝臣未有帶侍中、護軍、中正作州者，以卿故有此舉，放卿百餘日休息，至秋間當即追卿。」
units.en: Gao Zhan said to Yong, "No court minister has yet held Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Protects the Army, and Grand Rectifier while serving as a provincial governor; this move is because of you. I give you more than a hundred days of rest; in autumn I shall recall you at once."
units.literal: Gao Zhan said to Yong, "No court minister has yet held Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Protects the Army, and Grand Rectifier while serving as a provincial governor; this move is because of you. I give you more than a hundred days of rest; in autumn I shall recall you at once."

units.zh: 遷右僕射，又遷尚書令，封晉昌王，錄尚書事。
units.en: He was transferred to right vice director, then again to director of the masters of writing, enfeoffed as Prince of Jinchang, and made recorder of the masters of writing affairs.
units.literal: He was transferred to right vice director, then again to director of the masters of writing, enfeoffed as Prince of Jinchang, and made recorder of the masters of writing affairs.

units.zh: 屬周師來寇，丞相高阿那肱率兵赴援，邕配割不甚從允，因此有隙。
units.en: When Zhou troops came to raid, Chancellor Gao Anaigong led an army to relieve the siege; Tang Yong's supply allotments were not fully approved, and the two fell out.
units.literal: As Zhou troops came to raid, Chancellor Gao Anaigong led troops to the relief; Yong's allocations and distributions were not fully approved, and on this account a rift opened.

units.zh: 肱譖之，遣侍中斛律孝卿宣旨責讓，留身禁止，尋釋之。
units.en: Anaigong slandered him and sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Hulü Xiaoqing with an edict of rebuke; Tang Yong was held in custody, then soon released.
units.literal: Anaigong slandered him and sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Hulü Xiaoqing to proclaim an edict rebuking and reproaching him; Yong was detained in custody and soon released.

units.zh: 車駕將幸晉陽，勑孝卿總知騎兵度支，事多自決，不相詢稟。
units.en: As the emperor was about to visit Jinyang, an edict put Hulü Xiaoqing in overall charge of cavalry expenditures; he decided most matters himself and did not consult or report upward.
units.literal: As the imperial carriage was about to visit Jinyang, an edict ordered Xiaoqing to take overall charge of cavalry expenditures; he decided most matters on his own and did not consult or report upward.

units.zh: 邕自恃從霸朝以來常典樞要，歷事六帝，恩遇甚重，一旦為孝卿所輕，負氣鬱怏，形於辭色。
units.en: Tang Yong relied on having held pivotal posts since the hegemonic court, served six emperors, and enjoyed heavy favor—yet was suddenly slighted by Xiaoxiaoqing; bitter and sullen, he showed it in speech and face.
units.literal: Yong relied on himself—from the hegemonic court onward he had constantly held pivotal posts, served six emperors, and received very heavy favor—yet was suddenly slighted by Xiaoxiaoqing; resentful and sullen, he showed it in word and countenance.

units.zh: 帝平陽敗後，狼狽還鄴都。
units.en: After the emperor's defeat at Pingyang, he fled back to Ye in disarray.
units.literal: After the emperor's defeat at Pingyang, he returned to the capital Ye in disarray.

units.zh: 邕懼那肱譖之，恨斛律孝卿輕己，遂留晉陽，與莫多婁敬顯等崇樹安德王為帝。
units.en: Tang Yong feared Anaigong would slander him again and resented Hulü Xiaoqing's slight; he stayed at Jinyang and, with Moduolou Jingxian and others, elevated the Prince of Ande as emperor.
units.literal: Yong feared Anaigong would slander him again and hated that Hulü Xiaoqing slighted him; he therefore remained at Jinyang and, with Moduolou Jingxian and others, elevated the Prince of Ande as emperor.

units.zh: 信宿城陷，邕遂降周，依例授儀同大將軍。
units.en: Within a day or two the city fell; Tang Yong surrendered to Zhou and, by precedent, was made Yitong Grand General.
units.literal: Within a day or two the city fell; Yong then surrendered to Zhou and was appointed, by precedent, Yitong Grand General.

units.zh: 卒於鳳州刺史。
units.en: He died as governor of Feng Province.
units.literal: He died while serving as governor of Feng Province.

units.zh: 邕性識明敏，通解時事，齊氏一代，典執兵機。
units.en: Tang Yong was intelligent and keen by nature, understood current affairs, and throughout Northern Qi held command of military affairs.
units.literal: Yong was by nature intelligent and keen, understood current affairs, and throughout the Northern Qi line held command of military affairs.

units.zh: 凡是九州軍士、四方勇募，強弱多少，番代往還，及器械精粗、糧儲虛實，精心勤事，莫不諳知。
units.en: Troops of the nine provinces, valiant recruits from the four quarters, their strength and numbers, rotations, the quality of weapons, and the state of grain stores—he tracked all of it with keen care and knew it thoroughly.
units.literal: All troops of the nine provinces, valiant recruits from the four quarters, their strength and numbers, rotations coming and going, and the fineness of weapons and fullness or emptiness of grain stores—he worked at these with keen care and knew them all thoroughly.

units.zh: 自大寧以來，奢侈糜費，比及武平之末，府藏漸虛。
units.en: From the Daning era on, luxury and waste ran rampant; by the end of Wuping the treasury was gradually empty.
units.literal: From the Daning era onward luxury and waste ran rampant; by the end of Wuping the treasury stores were gradually depleted.

units.zh: 邕度支取捨，大有裨益。
units.en: Tang Yong's revenue and expenditure decisions brought great benefit.
units.literal: Yong's revenue decisions in expenditure brought great benefit.

units.zh: 然旣被任遇，意氣漸高，其未經府寺陳訴，越覽詞牒，條數甚多，俱為憲臺及左丞彈糾，並御注放免。
units.en: Yet once in favor his pride grew; many times he reviewed memorials without going through the offices, and the Censorate and left vice-director impeached him—all were pardoned by imperial note.
units.literal: Yet once favored in appointment his spirit grew gradually haughty; many cases in which he had not lodged petitions through the departmental offices but reviewed memorials on his own authority were impeached by the Censorate and the left vice-director—all were pardoned by imperial annotation.

units.zh: 司空從事中郎封長業、太尉記室參軍平濤並為徵官錢違限，邕各杖背二十。
units.en: Feng Changye, attendant of the Ministry of Works, and Ping Tao, secretary in the Grand Commandant's office, both exceeded the recruitment-money limit; Tang Yong had each flogged on the back twenty strokes.
units.literal: Attendant of the Ministry of Works Feng Changye and secretary of the Grand Commandant's office Ping Tao both exceeded the limit on recruitment money; Yong had each beaten on the back twenty strokes.

units.zh: 齊時宰相未有撾撻朝士者，至是甚駭物聽。
units.en: In Qi no chancellor had yet beaten a court gentleman; this greatly shocked public opinion.
units.literal: In Qi times no chancellor had yet beaten or flogged court gentlemen; at this the court was greatly shocked.

units.zh: 邕三子。
units.en: Tang Yong had three sons.
units.literal: Yong had three sons.

units.zh: 長子君明，開府儀同三司。
units.en: His eldest son Junming held the rank opening ritual, equal to the three dukes.
units.literal: His eldest son Junming held the rank Opening Ritual, Equal to the Three Dukes.

units.zh: 開皇初，卒於應州刺史。
units.en: At the beginning of Sui's Kaihuang era he died as governor of Ying Province.
units.literal: At the beginning of Sui's Kaihuang era he died as governor of Ying Province.

units.zh: 次子君徹，中書舍人，隋順、戎二州刺史，大業中，卒於武賁郎將。
units.en: His second son Junche was a secretariat gentleman and governor of Shun and Rong under Sui; in the Daye era he died as martial guard commandant.
units.literal: His second son Junche was secretariat gentleman; he served as governor of the two Sui provinces Shun and Rong; in the Daye era he died as martial guard commandant.

units.zh: 少子君德，以邕降周伏法。
units.en: His youngest son Junde was executed because Tang Yong had surrendered to Zhou.
units.literal: His youngest son Junde was executed by law because Yong had surrendered to Zhou.

units.zh: 齊朝因高祖作相，丞相府外兵曹、騎兵曹分掌兵馬。
units.en: In Northern Qi, when the Grand Ancestor became chancellor, the grand chancellor's external military bureau and cavalry bureau divided control of troops and horses.
units.literal: In Northern Qi, because the Grand Ancestor was made chancellor, the Grand Chancellor's office external military bureau and cavalry bureau divided control of troops and horses.

units.zh: 及天保受禪，諸司監咸歸尚書，唯此二曹不廢，令唐邕、白建主治，謂之外兵省、騎兵省。
units.en: When Tianbao received the mandate, all office supervisors went to the Masters of Writing, but these two bureaus remained; Tang Yong and Bai Jian headed them, called the External Troops Department and Cavalry Department.
units.literal: When Tianbao received the mandate, all office supervisors were folded into the Masters of Writing, but these two bureaus were not abolished; Tang Yong and Bai Jian were put in charge of them, called the External Troops Department and Cavalry Department.

units.zh: 其後邕、建位望轉隆，各為省主，令中書舍人分判二省事，故世稱唐、白云。
units.en: Later Yong and Jian rose higher; each became head of his department, with secretariat gentlemen to divide their affairs—hence the age called them Tang and Bai.
units.literal: Later Yong and Jian's standing grew ever loftier; each became head of his department; secretariat gentlemen were assigned to divide decisions on the two departments' affairs—hence the age called them Tang and Bai.

units.zh: 白建，字彥舉，太原陽邑人也。
units.en: Bai Jian, styled Yansu, was from Yangyi in Taiyuan.
units.literal: Bai Jian, styled Yansu, was a native of Yangyi in Taiyuan.

units.zh: 初入大丞相府騎兵曹，典執文帳，明解書計，為同局所推。
units.en: He first entered the grand chancellor's cavalry bureau, kept the clerical registers, understood accounts, and was promoted by colleagues in the same office.
units.literal: He first entered the Grand Chancellor's office cavalry bureau, kept charge of clerical registers, understood bookkeeping clearly, and was pushed forward by colleagues in the same office.

units.zh: 天保十年，兼中書舍人。
units.en: In the tenth year of Tianbao he was additionally made secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Tianbao he was additionally made secretariat gentleman.

units.zh: 肅宗輔政，除大丞相騎兵參軍。
units.en: When Suzong was regent he was appointed cavalry adjutant in the grand chancellor's office.
units.literal: When Suzong was regent he was appointed grand chancellor's office cavalry adjutant.

units.zh: 河清三年，突厥入境，代、忻二牧悉是細馬，合數萬匹，在五臺山北栢谷中避賊。
units.en: In the third year of Heqing, when Turks raided the border, the Dai and Xin herds—all fine horses, tens of thousands together—hid from bandits in Cypress Valley north of Mount Wutai.
units.literal: In the third year of Heqing, when the Turks invaded the border, the Dai and Xin herds were all fine horses, numbering tens of thousands together; they sheltered from bandits in Cypress Valley north of Mount Wutai.

units.zh: 賊退後，勑建就彼檢校，續使人詣建間領馬，送定州付民養飼。
units.en: After the raiders withdrew, an edict sent Jian to inspect; messengers kept coming for him to take the horses and send them to Ding Province for the people to raise.
units.literal: After the bandits retreated, an edict ordered Jian to go there and inspect; messengers were continually sent to Jian to take over the horses and deliver them to Ding Province to be given to the people for raising and feeding.

units.zh: 建以馬久不得食，瘦弱，遠送恐多死損，遂違勑以便宜從事，隨近散付軍人。
units.en: Jian judged the horses had long gone unfed and were thin; a long haul would kill many, so he disobeyed the edict, acted as expedient required, and distributed them nearby to soldiers.
units.literal: Jian judged that the horses had long gone without food and were emaciated; sending them far he feared many would die in transit; he therefore disobeyed the edict and acted on expedient grounds, dispersing and entrusting them nearby to soldiers.

units.zh: 啟知，勑許焉。
units.en: He reported; the emperor learned and approved by edict.
units.literal: He reported and the emperor learned; an edict permitted it.

units.zh: 戎乘無損，建有力焉。
units.en: The war horses suffered no loss—Jian had credit for this.
units.literal: The war horses suffered no loss—Jian had merit in this.

units.zh: 武平末，歷特進、侍中、中書令。
units.en: At the end of Wuping he rose through special advance, attendant-in-ordinary, and chief minister of the secretariat.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping he rose through special advance, attendant-in-ordinary, and chief minister of the secretariat.

units.zh: 建雖無他才，勤於在公。
units.en: Jian had no other talent but was diligent in public affairs.
units.literal: Jian had no other talent but was diligent in public duty.

units.zh: 屬王業始基，戎寄為重，建與唐邕俱以典執兵馬致位卿相。
units.en: As the royal enterprise was just beginning and military trust was weighty, Jian and Tang Yong both reached minister and chancellor by holding charge of troops and horses.
units.literal: As the royal enterprise was just beginning and military trust was weighty, Jian and Tang Yong both rose to minister and chancellor by keeping charge of troops and horses.

units.zh: 晉陽，國之下都，每年臨幸，徵詔差科，責成州郡。
units.en: Jinyang was the realm's lower capital; each year the emperor visited, and levies and corvée fell on the provinces and commanderies.
units.literal: Jinyang was the realm's lower capital; each year the emperor visited it; levies and corvée were dispatched, responsibility fixed on the provinces and commanderies.

units.zh: 本藩僚佐爰及守宰，諮承陳請，趨走無暇。
units.en: Retainers and magistrates of his original domain came to consult and petition—they had no rest.
units.literal: Retainers and administrators of his original domain, and even district magistrates, came to consult and present requests—they had no leisure to rest.

units.zh: 諸子幼稚，俱為州郡主簿，新君選補，必先召辟。
units.en: Though his sons were still young, all became provincial chief clerks; when the new ruler made appointments, they were always summoned first.
units.literal: Though his sons were still young, all became chief clerks in the provinces and commanderies; when the new ruler chose and appointed, they were always summoned and engaged first.

units.zh: 男婚女嫁，皆得勝流。
units.en: Sons' marriages and daughters' weddings all matched leading families.
units.literal: When sons married and daughters wed, they all won eminent company.

units.zh: 當世以為榮寵之極。
units.en: The age took this as the height of honor and favor.
units.literal: The age regarded this as the summit of honor and favor.

units.zh: 武平七年卒。
units.en: In the seventh year of Wuping he died.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Wuping he died.

units.zh: 舊式，百日不上解官，吏部尚書尉瑾性褊急，以瞻舉指舒緩，曹務繁劇，遂附驛奏聞，因而被代。
units.en: Under the old rule, an official absent for one hundred days was removed. Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was narrow and impatient; because Zhan moved slowly while bureau business was heavy and urgent, Wei sent a memorial by post, and Zhan was replaced.
units.literal: Under the old rule, an official who did not appear for one hundred days was removed from office; Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was narrow and impatient by nature, and because Zhan's movements were slow and the bureau's affairs were numerous and urgent, he sent a memorial by post, and Zhan was replaced as a result.

units.zh: 神武明皇后婁氏，諱昭君，贈司徒內干之女也。
units.en: Empress Ming, née Lou, whose personal name was Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Empress Ming, Lady Lou, taboo name Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 神武婁后
units.en: Empress Lou of Shenwu
units.literal: Empress Lou of Shenwu

units.zh: 及拜渤海王妃，閫闈之事悉決焉。
units.en: When she was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.
units.literal: When he was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.

units.zh: 文襄嗣位，進為太妃。
units.en: When Gao Cheng succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.
units.literal: When Wenxiang succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.

units.zh: 天保初，尊為皇太后，宮曰宣訓。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianbao era, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.

units.zh: 孝昭即位，復為皇太后。
units.en: When Gao Yan succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 濟南即位，尊為太皇太后。
units.en: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 太皇太后密與孝昭及諸大將定策誅之，下令廢立。
units.en: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Gao Yan and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing one ruler and enthroning another.
units.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Xiaozhao and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing and enthroning.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，太后寢疾，衣忽自舉，用巫媼言改姓石氏。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.

units.zh: 孝昭帝崩，太后又下詔立武成帝。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 及見神武於城上執役，驚曰：「此真吾夫也。」
units.en: When she saw Gao Huan laboring on the city wall, she started and said, "This is truly my husband."
units.literal: When she saw Shenwu performing labor on the city wall, she was startled and said: "This is truly my husband."

units.zh: 乃使婢通意，又數致私財，使以聘己，父母不得已而許焉。
units.en: She sent a maid to convey her feelings and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.
units.literal: She then sent a maid to convey her feelings, and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.

units.zh: 弟昭，以功名自達，其餘親屬，未嘗為請爵位。
units.en: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.
units.literal: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.

units.zh: 太后凡孕六男二女，皆感夢：孕文襄則夢一斷龍；
units.en: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Gao Cheng she dreamed of a severed dragon;
units.literal: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Wenxiang she dreamed of a severed dragon;

units.zh: 孕文宣則夢大龍，首尾屬天地，張口動目，勢狀驚人；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yang she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;
units.literal: when she conceived Wenxuan she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;

units.zh: 孕孝昭則夢蠕龍於地；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yan she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;
units.literal: when she conceived Xiaozhao she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;

units.zh: 孕武成則夢龍浴於海；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Zhan she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;
units.literal: when she conceived Wucheng she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;

units.zh: 孕魏二后並夢月入懷；
units.en: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;
units.literal: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;

units.zh: 孕襄城、博陵二王夢鼠入衣下。
units.en: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.
units.literal: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.

units.zh: 四月辛丑，崩於北宮，時年六十二。
units.en: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.
units.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.

units.zh: 五月甲申，合葬義平陵。
units.en: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Gao Huan at Yiping Tomb.
units.literal: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Shenwu at Yiping Tomb.

units.zh: 文宣將受魏禪，后固執不許，帝所以中止。
units.en: When Gao Yang was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.
units.literal: When Wenxuan was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.

units.zh: 神武嘗將西討出師，後夜孿生一男一女，左右以危急，請追告神武。
units.en: Once, as Gao Huan was about to march west on campaign, the empress gave birth at night to twins, a boy and a girl. Those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after him.
units.literal: Once when Shenwu was about to march west on campaign, the empress at night bore twins, a boy and a girl; those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after Shenwu.

units.zh: 后弗聽曰：「王出統大兵，何得以我故輕離軍幕。
units.en: The empress would not hear of it. "The king has gone forth to command a great army," she said. "He cannot lightly leave the command tent on my account.
units.literal: The empress would not listen and said: "The king has gone forth to command a great army — how can he lightly leave the command tent on my account.

units.zh: 死生命也，來復何為！」
units.en: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"
units.literal: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"

units.zh: 沙苑敗後，侯景屢言請精騎二萬，必能取之。
units.en: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover the lost ground.
units.literal: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover it.

units.zh: 神武悅，以告于后。
units.en: Gao Huan was pleased and told the empress.
units.literal: Shenwu was pleased and told the empress.

units.zh: 后曰：「若如其言，豈有還理，得獺失景，亦有何利。」
units.en: The empress said, "If things go as he promises, there would be no reason for him to return. You would gain some paltry conquest and lose Hou Jing; there would be no profit in that."
units.literal: The empress said: "If it comes about as he says, could there be any coming back — gain the otter, lose Jing; what profit is there."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: Thereupon he desisted.
units.literal: Thereupon he desisted.

units.zh: 及茹茹公主至，后避正室處之。
units.en: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.
units.literal: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.

units.zh: 后曰：「國家大計，願不疑也。」
units.en: The empress said, "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."
units.literal: The empress said: "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."

units.zh: 性寬厚，不妒忌，神武姬侍，咸加恩待。
units.en: Her nature was generous and free of jealousy; Gao Huan's concubines and attendants she treated with equal favor.
units.literal: Her nature was generous and she was not jealous; Shenwu's concubines and attendants she all treated with favor.

units.zh: 后高明嚴斷，雅遵儉約，往來外舍，侍從不過十人。
units.en: The empress was lofty in judgment, clear-minded, and stern; she always observed thrift, and when she went out to external residences her attendants never exceeded ten.
units.literal: The empress was lofty, clear, and stern in judgment; she always observed thrift; when going out to external residences, her attendants never exceeded ten.

units.zh: 神武既有澄清之志，傾產以結英豪，密謀秘策，后恒參預。
units.en: Once Gao Huan resolved to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems Empress Lou always took part.
units.literal: Once Shenwu had the will to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems the empress always took part.

units.zh: 后未崩，有童謠曰「九龍母死不作孝」。
units.en: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme ran: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."
units.literal: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme said: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."

units.zh: 及后崩，武成不改服，緋袍如故。
units.en: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.
units.literal: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.

units.zh: 論曰：神武肇興齊業，武明追蹤周亂。
units.en: The appraisal says: Shenwu founded Qi's enterprise, but Wuming followed the path of Zhou's disorder.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Shenwu first raised the enterprise of Qi, but Wuming followed the track of Zhou's disorder.

units.zh: 從祖兄長粲。
units.en: His elder clan cousin was Changcan.
units.literal: His elder clan cousin was Changcan.

units.zh: 胡長仁，字孝隆，安定臨涇人，武成皇後之兄。
units.en: Hu Changren, styled Xiaolong, was from Linjing in Anding and elder brother of Wucheng’s Empress Hu.
units.literal: Hu Changren, courtesy name Xiaolong, was a native of Linjing in Anding and elder brother of Empress Hu of Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 長粲少而敏悟，以外戚起家給事中，遷黃門侍郎。
units.en: Changcan was quick and perceptive in youth. As an imperial in-law, he began his career as palace attendant and was transferred to gentleman attendant at the Yellow Gate.
units.literal: Changcan was quick and perceptive in youth; as an imperial in-law he began his career as palace attendant and was transferred to gentleman attendant at the Yellow Gate.

units.zh: 世祖崩，與領軍婁定遠、錄尚書趙彥深、和士開、高文遙、領軍綦連猛、高阿那肱、樸射唐邕同知朝政，時人號為八貴。
units.en: When Shizu died, he jointly directed court government with Lou Dingyuan, Zhao Yanshen, He Shikai, Gao Wenyao, Qilian Meng, Gao Anagong, and Vice Director Tang Yong. People of the time called them the Eight Nobles.
units.literal: When Shizu died, he, together with army commander Lou Dingyuan, recorder of the Masters of Writing Zhao Yanshen, He Shikai, Gao Wenyao, army commander Qilian Meng, Gao Anagong, and vice director Tang Yong, jointly directed court government; people of the time called them the Eight Nobles.

units.zh: 後主踐祚，長粲被勑與黃門馮子琮出入禁中，專典敷奏。
units.en: When the Later Sovereign ascended, Changcan was ordered, together with Yellow Gate attendant Feng Zicong, to enter and leave the palace precincts and handle the presentation of memorials.
units.literal: When the Later Sovereign ascended the throne, Changcan was ordered, together with Yellow Gate attendant Feng Zicong, to enter and leave the forbidden precincts and exclusively manage the presentation of memorials.

units.zh: 父僧敬，即魏孝靜帝之舅，位至司空。
units.en: His father Sengjing was the maternal uncle of Emperor Xiaojing of Wei and rose to Minister of Works.
units.literal: His father Sengjing was the maternal uncle of Emperor Xiaojing of Wei and rose in office to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 又為侍中。
units.en: He also became palace attendant.
units.literal: He also became palace attendant.

units.zh: 除趙州刺史。
units.en: Changcan was appointed inspector of Zhaozhou.
units.literal: Changcan was appointed inspector of Zhaozhou.

units.zh: 於後定遠、文遙並出，唐邕專典外兵，綦連猛、高阿那肱別總武任，長粲常在左右，兼宣詔令，從幸晉陽。
units.en: Afterward Dingyuan and Wenyao were sent out, Tang Yong managed the external troops, Qilian Meng and Gao Anagong separately oversaw military duties, and Changcan remained constantly at the sovereign's side, proclaiming edicts and following him to Jinyang.
units.literal: Afterward Dingyuan and Wenyao were both sent out, Tang Yong exclusively managed the external troops, Qilian Meng and Gao Anagong separately supervised military responsibilities, and Changcan was constantly at the sovereign's side, also proclaiming edicts and orders, and followed the imperial visit to Jinyang.

units.zh: 後主即位，富於春秋，庶事皆歸委長粲，長粲盡心毗奉，甚得名譽。
units.en: When the Later Sovereign took the throne, he was still young, so all affairs were entrusted to Changcan. Changcan devoted himself to supporting and serving him and gained a strong reputation.
units.literal: When the Later Sovereign took the throne, he was young in years, and all affairs were entrusted to Changcan; Changcan devoted his heart to supporting and serving him and gained a great reputation.

units.zh: 至州，因沐髮手不得舉，失音，卒。
units.en: After arriving in the province, he was washing his hair when his hand would no longer lift; he lost his voice and died.
units.literal: After arriving in the province, while washing his hair his hand could not be raised; he lost his voice and died.

units.zh: 長仁心欲入處機要之地，為執政不許，長仁疑長粲通謀，大以為恨。
units.en: Changren wanted to enter the key councils, but those in power would not permit it. Suspecting that Changcan had conspired against him, Changren deeply resented him.
units.literal: Changren wished in his heart to enter a place of vital importance, but those in power did not permit it; Changren suspected that Changcan had conspired in this and deeply resented him.

units.zh: 遂言於太后，發其陰私，請出為州，後主不得已從焉。
units.en: He then spoke to the empress dowager, exposed Changcan's private misconduct, and asked that he be sent out to a province; the Later Sovereign had no choice but to agree.
units.literal: He then spoke to the empress dowager, exposed Changcan's private misconduct, and requested that he be sent out to a province; the Later Sovereign had no choice but to follow this.

units.zh: 及辭，長粲流涕，後主亦憫默。
units.en: When Changcan took leave, he wept, and the Later Sovereign too fell silent in pity.
units.literal: When he took leave, Changcan shed tears, and the Later Sovereign too was silent with pity.

units.zh: 武成使元文遙就州宣勑曰：「馮翊王少小謹慎，在州不為非法，朕信之熟矣。
units.en: Gao Zhan sent Yuan Wenyao with an edict: "Prince Run has been careful from youth and committed no crime in office — I know him thoroughly.
units.literal: Wucheng sent Yuan Wenyao to the province with an edict, saying, "Prince of Fengyi Run has been careful from youth; at his post he has committed no wrong — I know him well.

units.zh: 瑯邪王儼惡之，與領軍庫狄伏連、侍中馮子琮、禦史王子宜、武衛高舍洛等謀誅之。
units.en: Prince Yan of Langye hated him and, with Army Director Kudie Fulian, Attendant Feng Zicong, Censor Wang Ziyi, Martial Guard Gao Shelou, and others, plotted his death.
units.literal: Prince of Langye Yan hated him and, with Army Director Kudie Fulian, Attendant-in-Ordinary Feng Zicong, Censor Wang Ziyi, and Martial Guard Gao Shelou and others, plotted to kill him.

units.zh: 其年七月二十五日旦，士開依式早參，伏連前把士開手曰：「今有一大好事。」
units.en: On the morning of the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month, Shikai came for the regular audience; Fulian seized his hand and said, "Today brings great good fortune."
units.literal: On the morning of the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month that year, Shikai came for the regular early audience; Fulian stepped forward and took Shikai's hand, saying, "Today there is a great piece of good news."

units.zh: 後誅儼等。
units.en: Later Yan and his accomplices were put to death.
units.literal: Later Yan and the others were executed.

units.zh: 儼遣都督馮永洛就臺斬之，時年四十八，簿錄其家口。
units.en: Yan sent Commander Feng Yongluo to behead him at the tribunal; he was forty-eight, and his household was registered and seized.
units.literal: Yan sent Commander Feng Yongluo to the tribunal to behead him; he was forty-eight years old, and his household register was seized for inventory.

units.zh: 及帝將建中宮，高隆之、高德正言漢婦人不可為天下母，宜更擇美配。
units.en: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.
units.literal: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.

units.zh: 而德正猶固請廢后而立段昭儀，欲以結勳貴之援，帝竟不從而立后焉。
units.en: Yet Dezheng still firmly asked to depose the empress and install Lady Duan as Honored Consort, wishing thereby to win the support of meritorious nobles; the emperor in the end did not follow him and established the empress.
units.literal: Yet Dezheng still firmly asked to depose the empress and install Lady Duan as Honored Consort, wishing thereby to win the support of meritorious nobles; the emperor in the end did not follow him and established the empress.

units.zh: 唐邕、白建方貴，時人言云：「幷州赫赫唐與白。」
units.en: Tang Yong and Bai Jian were then in high favor; people said, "In Bingzhou, Tang and Bai blaze bright."
units.literal: Tang Yong and Bai Jian were then in high favor; people said, "In Bingzhou, Tang and Bai blaze bright."

units.zh: 元日，對邕為諸令史祝曰：「見卿等位當作唐、白。」
units.en: On New Year's Day, facing Yong, he said to the clerks in blessing, "May you gentlemen in rank become Tang and Bai."
units.literal: On New Year's Day, facing Yong, he said to the clerks in blessing, "May you gentlemen in rank become Tang and Bai."

units.zh: 右丞相、長廣王湛研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑，可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，征王統茲大寶。
units.en: Prince Zhan of Changguang, right chancellor, understands hidden workings and change, embodies the Way, and stands foremost among the clan. The whole realm looks to him as a hero among men. Born of the same mother and sharing the same breath, he is the support of house and state. Send Prince Rui of Zhaojun, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to convey my intent and summon him to take charge of the throne.
units.literal: The Right Chancellor, Prince Zhan of Changguang, studies subtle workings and fathoms transformation, embodies the Way and stands within the clan; as a hero among men, he is looked up to within the seas. Of the same womb and shared breath, he is one on whom house and state rely. The Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Rui of Zhaojun, may be sent to explain the intent and summon the prince to govern this great treasure.

units.zh: 趙郡王叡與厙狄顯安侍坐，帝曰：「須拔我同堂弟，顯安我親姑子，今序家人禮，除君臣之敬，可言我之不逮。」
units.en: Prince of Zhao Gao Rui and Kudi Xian'an were seated in attendance. The emperor said, "Xu Ba is my cousin; Xian'an is my aunt's son. Today we observe family etiquette and put aside the formalities of ruler and subject—you may tell me where I fall short."
units.literal: Prince of Zhao Rui and Kudi Xian'an were in attendance seated beside him. The Emperor said: "Xu Ba is my paternal cousin; Xian'an is the son of my paternal aunt. Today let us observe family rites and set aside the respect due between ruler and minister—you may speak of where I fall short.

units.zh: 武成崩，尊為皇太后，陸媼及和士開密謀殺趙郡王叡，出婁定遠、高文遙為刺史。
units.en: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.
units.literal: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.

units.zh: 時馮子琮子慈明、祖珽子君信並相繼居中書，故時語云：「馮、祖及趙，穢我鳳池。」
units.en: At the time Feng Zicong's son Ciming and Zu Ting's son Junxin took the secretariat in turn, so people said, "Feng, Zu, and Zhao — they're fouling the phoenix pool."
units.literal: At the time Feng Zicong's son Ciming and Zu Ting's son Junxin in succession held posts in the secretariat, so the saying ran: "Feng, Zu, and Zhao are befouling our phoenix pool."
